onboarding.title: Choose your language
onboarding.subtitle: Plant names, uses, and the AI assistant will all speak this language. You can change it any time in Settings.

bands.likelyHelp: Probable. Verify before relying on it.
bands.uncertainHelp: Low confidence. Treat as a guess.

identify.title: Identify a plant
identify.subtitle: Photograph one leaf, flower, fruit, or piece of bark. You get an AI identification with a confidence score, and your observation becomes survey-grade data.
identify.analyzingHint: Comparing shapes, veins, and textures against thousands of species.
identify.qualityBlur: Hold still and tap to focus on a single leaf or flower.
identify.qualityDark: Find more light. The photo is underexposed.
identify.qualityBright: The photo is overexposed. Move out of direct sun.
identify.qualityLowContrast: Move closer so one leaf or flower fills the frame.
identify.locationPoor: GPS accuracy is only {{m}} m. Drag the pin to where the plant really is.
identify.locationSimulated: Location unavailable, using the demo location. Drag the pin to adjust.
identify.emptyBody: Snap a single leaf or flower to begin. Every observation you save becomes survey-grade data for local research.
identify.noNearby: No campaigns near you right now.
identify.photoTooLarge: That image could not be read. Try another photo.

result.neverCertain: AI identifications are never certain. The score shows how sure the model is.
result.savedBody: It is now part of the dataset and visible to researchers on the agency map.
result.habitatPlaceholder: Where is it growing? Shade, wet soil, roadside, a garden wall…
result.voiceUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser. Type instead.
result.sensitiveNotice: Sensitive species. Its public location is rounded to protect it; only verified researchers see the exact point.
result.invasiveBody: This species is listed as invasive here. Reporting it helps local control programs act quickly.

uses.title: What this plant does
uses.lockedBody: Edible and medicinal notes only unlock when the identification scores 85 or above. This one scored {{score}}. A wrong ID here could be dangerous.
uses.disclaimer: For learning only. This is not a foraging, medical, or safety guide. Never eat, touch, or use a plant based on an app identification.
uses.sourceClaude: Notes generated by Claude for this photo
uses.sourceLibrary: Notes from the EcoBuddi species library

chat.title: Ask about this plant
chat.subtitle: Follow-up questions about the photo and the chosen species.
chat.suggestion3: How do I tell it from look-alikes?
chat.error: Could not reach the assistant. Try again.
chat.demoNote: Demo answers come from the species library, not a live model.

records.title: My Records
records.subtitle: {{count}} observations
records.emptyBody: Your saved observations will appear here, with their confidence, location, and campaign matches.
records.deleteConfirm: Delete this observation? This cannot be undone.
records.sensitiveExact: Exact location hidden for sensitive species
records.notFound: That record could not be found.

nearby.title: Nearby
nearby.subtitle: Campaigns and recent observations around you
nearby.noCampaigns: No campaigns in this area yet.
nearby.mapAria: Map of nearby campaigns and observations

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHelp: Used for the interface, plant notes, voice, and every AI request.
settings.testSentence: Hello from EcoBuddi. This is how plant notes will sound.
settings.resetConfirm: This replaces all observations and campaigns with fresh seed data.
settings.privacy: No ads, no tracking, no analytics. Everything stays on your device except the photo sent to the identification server.
settings.installHint: Add EcoBuddi to your home screen for the full-screen experience.
settings.installIos: On iPhone: tap Share, then "Add to Home Screen".
settings.aiDemo: Demo mode. No API key on the server, so the bundled identifier answers.
settings.observerHelp: Shown to researchers next to your records.

report.title: Report invasive species
report.body: This report is pre-filled from your observation. Send it to your local invasive species program.
report.subject: Invasive species sighting: {{species}}
report.programHint: In the UK, sightings can be logged with the GB Non-native Species Secretariat. Elsewhere, search for your regional invasive species program.

agency.verifiedBuyerHelp: Shows exact coordinates for sensitive species. Off by default.
agency.researchGradeHelp: Share of records verified by the community or an expert

queue.title: Verification queue
queue.subtitle: {{count}} observations awaiting review
queue.emptyBody: Every observation has been reviewed. New records will appear here as they arrive.
queue.correctHelp: Pick another candidate or type the correct name

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: Paid data campaigns for agencies and researchers
campaigns.name: Title
campaigns.descriptionPlaceholder: What this campaign is for and who runs it
campaigns.drawHint: Tap the map to add corners. Tap Finish when the area is closed.
campaigns.centerHint: Tap the map to set the center, then adjust the radius.
campaigns.bountyHelp: Points awarded to the observer for each matching record
campaigns.coverageHelp: Share of {{m}} m grid cells inside the region with at least one record
campaigns.deleteConfirm: Delete this campaign? Records stay but lose their link.
campaigns.noRecords: No records yet for this campaign.
campaigns.invalid: Add a title, at least one species, a region, and valid dates.
campaigns.emptyBody: Create the first campaign to start collecting targeted records.

export.title: Export
export.subtitle: Download the filtered dataset for analysis or GIS
export.note: Sensitive species coordinates are rounded to two decimal places unless the verified buyer view is on.
export.filtersApply: The map filters apply to the export.
export.fileHint: Files download to this device. Nothing is uploaded.

pwa.installBody: Add it to your home screen for a full-screen field app.

errors.identifyFailed: Identification failed. Showing the demo identifier instead.
errors.cameraUnavailable: Camera not available. Choose a photo from your gallery.
errors.storage: Could not save to this device.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.subtitle: Ranked by the number of different species photographed
leaderboard.empty: No observations yet. Photograph a plant to get on the board.
